requirement_text.REQ-396: Add HUMAN_TASK.escalation_timer_duration to graph schema and wire SCH-04 escalation half (timer fire -> original task non-actionable, new task assigned to escalation role), closing REQ-185/REQ-188 deferral. WHAT EXISTS: POST /instances/:id/advance-timer force-fires any pending TIMER node. Letflow.Definitions.Graph validates :TIMER nodes with duration_iso8601 (CHK-12). WHAT DOES NOT EXIST: No way to attach a timeout to a :HUMAN_TASK node to (a) race the human completing it, (b) firing first makes original task non-actionable, (c) creates new task assigned to escalation role. process_route_approval.yaml's ops-review node has no path to ceo-approval on timeout. SCOPE: (1) CODE-DESIGNER decides schema shape (escalation_timer_duration ISO-8601 + escalation_role attribute, or boundary-timer node alternative), produces design doc; (2) ELIXIR-DEV wires Engine/Scheduler: fired escalation timer marks original HUMAN_TASK non-actionable (audit event before escalation task), creates new task assigned to escalation role; (3) update process_route_approval.yaml ops-review node for timeout path to ceo-approval. NOT IN SCOPE: REQ-185/186/187/188 recurring-timer machinery; REQ-395 live deployment; ISS-0739 credential seeding. ACs: design doc with CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR sign-off citing REQ-185/REQ-188 blocker; Graph validates new attributes; ExUnit test proves timer fire -> (a) non-actionable original task, (b) one new task to escalation role, (c) audit event ordering; process_route_approval.yaml updated with end-to-end test; UAT re-run (deferred to REQ-395+ISS-0739 landing); mix test + compile pass.
